nodes.description: Public token symbol string state variable, set to "NSC" in the Noscam constructor.
Public token name string state variable, set to "NOSCAM" in the Noscam constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals state variable, set to 4 in the Noscam constructor.
Public uint total token supply state variable, 210000000000 base units.
mapping(address => uint) holding every account token balance.

Public address of the current contract owner, gate for the onlyOwner modifier.
Public address of the pending new owner during the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath addition helper: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath subtraction helper: require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath division helper: require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into the newOwner state variable.
Completes the ownership handover, requires msg.sender == newOwner, then resets newOwner.
Noscam token constructor: sets metadata, mints the whole supply and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer using safeSub/safeAdd on balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance and moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing plain ETH.
onlyOwner function that externally calls tokenAddress.transfer(owner, tokens).
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made after allowance write; reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token contract.
Unchecked uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().

edges.reason: Caller-controlled msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender flows into transferOwnership through the onlyOwner modifier check.
transferOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), an access-control dependency on the caller.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender indexes balances in transfer, determining the debited account.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed and is forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
msg.sender reaching the fallback triggers the unconditional revert.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner) via onlyOwner.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
Constructor writes the entire supply into balances at the deployer address.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its subtraction.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
Constructor sets _totalSupply = 210000000000.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
Constructor sets symbol = "NSC".
Constructor sets name = "NOSCAM".
Constructor sets decimals = 4.
transferOwnership is guarded by the owner state variable in onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership reads owner when emitting OwnershipTransferred and then overwrites it.
transferAnyERC20Token uses owner as the destination and as the onlyOwner guard.
transferOwnership overwrites the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and then clears newOwner.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner = _newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor mints the supply by assigning balances[deployer] = _totalSupply.
Constructor initializes the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and the allowance deduction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked uint subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
approveAndCall hands control to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval after the allowance write.
A malicious spender can re-enter transfer from inside receiveApproval.
A malicious spender can re-enter approve from inside receiveApproval.
A malicious spender can re-enter transferFrom from inside receiveApproval.
A malicious spender can recursively re-enter approveAndCall itself.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an arbitrary, potentially malicious token contract at tokenAddress.
